page.overview:
Who is Amelia Everett?

Dr. Amelia "Mia" Everett was a computational geneticist, who worked for Dr. Henry Wu on a top secret Behavioral Genomics project working on Velociraptors from 2012, until the fall of Jurassic World in the N.M.S. Genetics Centre in Jurassic World: Aftermath. In 2017, she helped a silent security expert, named Sam to find his way throughout the island after their plane crashed.

During the game, Mia mentions that, Residence was the place where she presumably spent her late twenties entirely. If she was 30, during the events of Aftermath, it is possible that, Mia had witnessed the San Diego Incident and other InGen-related events and revelations, which most likely had led to her developing an interest in genetics.

Under Dr. Wu's supervision, Mia oversaw the creation of 3 highly genetically-tampered, Velociraptors, one of whom was highly social, due to the high levels of a hormone in it's body. During this time, the existence of these Velociraptors was hidden from both the public and several park workers, including Vic Hoskins and Owen Grady.

Before the Indominus rex broke out, Mia had an argument with Wu, and both of them parted ways. During the fall of Jurassic World, Mia, alongside other personnel on the island, evacuated the park.
